How to use

To use the Daiwa BG 5000H 2016 Spinning Reel, securely attach it to your fishing rod following the rod manufacturer’s instructions. Spool your preferred fishing line onto the reel, ensuring it is evenly distributed. Adjust the drag setting according to the targeted fish species and fishing conditions to prevent line breakage. After fishing, rinse the reel with fresh water to remove salt and debris, and lubricate moving parts periodically to maintain smooth operation.

Care instructions

Clean the reel with fresh water after each use, especially after saltwater fishing, to prevent corrosion. Use a soft cloth to wipe it down and remove any dirt or debris. Regularly check and lubricate the reel’s moving parts according to the manufacturer’s guidelines to ensure optimal performance. Avoid exposing the reel to extreme temperatures or harsh chemicals to prolong its lifespan.
